text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A-A reward!?
I see, a reward, huh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am used to respect and gratitude,
so hearing it called a reward took me by surprise.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"You always say things that fly right past
all my expectations... Fufu."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—However, no gifts are necessary.
I shall simply accept the thought.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Because simply taking part in a race
where Umamusume clash fiercely was more than enough
to make it deeply rewarding!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Naturally, that is my intention. This victory is merely one step on the path to glory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Until I reach those heights one day,
all I can do is push forward with unyielding courage.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, you'll be accompanying me until that day arrives,
Trainer-kun!"
